decisions.quote: The trial, results of which were published online Nov. 23, 2016, in JAMA Psychiatry, failed to replicate results of an earlier study indicating that omega‐3s were superior to placebo in reducing the risk of transition to psychosis.
decisions.reason: This article is a secondary news summary reporting on a clinical trial published separately in JAMA Psychiatry rather than a study that itself collects or re-analyzes data to re-test an earlier finding.
